<?php

$n = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$digits = array_map('intval', str_split($n));
$length = count($digits);

$bitCount = array_fill(0, 1024, 0);
for ($i = 1; $i < 1024; $i++) {
    $bitCount[$i] = $bitCount[$i >> 1] + ($i & 1);
}

$memo = [];

$dfs = function (int $pos, bool $tight, bool $started, int $mask) use (
    &$dfs,
    &$memo,
    $digits,
    $length,
    $bitCount
): int {
    if ($pos === $length) {
        return $started ? 1 : 0;
    }

    $key = $pos . ':' . (int)$tight . ':' . (int)$started . ':' . $mask;
    if (isset($memo[$key])) {
        return $memo[$key];
    }

    $limit = $tight ? $digits[$pos] : 9;
    $result = 0;

    for ($digit = 0; $digit <= $limit; $digit++) {
        $nextTight = $tight && ($digit === $limit);

        if (!$started && $digit === 0) {
            $result += $dfs($pos + 1, $nextTight, false, 0);
        } else {
            $nextMask = $mask | (1 << $digit);
            if ($bitCount[$nextMask] <= 2) {
                $result += $dfs($pos + 1, $nextTight, true, $nextMask);
            }
        }
    }

    return $memo[$key] = $result;
};

echo $dfs(0, true, false, 0), PHP_EOL;

<?php

$n = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$digits = array_map('intval', str_split($n));
$valid = array_fill(0, 1024, false);

for ($mask = 0; $mask < 1024; $mask++) {
    $valid[$mask] = substr_count(decbin($mask), '1') <= 2;
}

$dp = [[], [0 => 1]];

foreach ($digits as $digit) {
    $next = [[], []];

    for ($tight = 0; $tight <= 1; $tight++) {
        foreach ($dp[$tight] as $mask => $count) {
            $limit = $tight ? $digit : 9;

            for ($d = 0; $d <= $limit; $d++) {
                $newTight = ($tight && $d === $digit) ? 1 : 0;
                $newMask = ($mask === 0 && $d === 0)
                    ? 0
                    : ($mask | (1 << $d));

                if ($valid[$newMask]) {
                    $next[$newTight][$newMask] =
                        ($next[$newTight][$newMask] ?? 0) + $count;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    $dp = $next;
}

$answer = 0;

for ($tight = 0; $tight <= 1; $tight++) {
    foreach ($dp[$tight] as $mask => $count) {
        if ($mask !== 0) {
            $answer += $count;
        }
    }
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;

<?php

$n = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$digits = array_map('intval', str_split($n));

$popcount = array_fill(0, 1024, 0);
for ($i = 1; $i < 1024; $i++) {
    $popcount[$i] = $popcount[$i >> 1] + ($i & 1);
}

$dp = [[], [0 => 1]];

foreach ($digits as $currentDigit) {
    $next = [[], []];

    for ($tight = 0; $tight <= 1; $tight++) {
        foreach ($dp[$tight] as $mask => $count) {
            $limit = $tight ? $currentDigit : 9;

            for ($digit = 0; $digit <= $limit; $digit++) {
                $newTight = ($tight && $digit === $currentDigit) ? 1 : 0;

                if ($mask === 0 && $digit === 0) {
                    $newMask = 0;
                } else {
                    $newMask = $mask | (1 << $digit);
                    if ($popcount[$newMask] > 2) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                $next[$newTight][$newMask] =
                    ($next[$newTight][$newMask] ?? 0) + $count;
            }
        }
    }

    $dp = $next;
}

$result = 0;
for ($tight = 0; $tight <= 1; $tight++) {
    foreach ($dp[$tight] as $mask => $count) {
        if ($mask !== 0) {
            $result += $count;
        }
    }
}

echo $result . PHP_EOL;

<?php

$n = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$length = strlen($n);

$bitCount = array_fill(0, 1024, 0);
for ($mask = 1; $mask < 1024; $mask++) {
    $bitCount[$mask] = $bitCount[$mask >> 1] + ($mask & 1);
}

$dp = [1024 => 1]; // state = tight * 1024 + used-digit mask

for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
    $currentDigit = (int)$n[$i];
    $next = [];

    foreach ($dp as $state => $count) {
        $tight = intdiv($state, 1024);
        $mask = $state % 1024;
        $limit = $tight ? $currentDigit : 9;

        for ($digit = 0; $digit <= $limit; $digit++) {
            $newTight = ($tight && $digit === $limit) ? 1 : 0;

            if ($mask === 0 && $digit === 0) {
                $newMask = 0;
            } else {
                $newMask = $mask | (1 << $digit);
                if ($bitCount[$newMask] > 2) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            $newState = $newTight * 1024 + $newMask;
            $next[$newState] = ($next[$newState] ?? 0) + $count;
        }
    }

    $dp = $next;
}

$answer = 0;
foreach ($dp as $state => $count) {
    if ($state % 1024 !== 0) {
        $answer += $count;
    }
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;
